title: Suspicious transaction alert
description: Alert customers about an unusual card transaction on WhatsApp and let them confirm or block it in one tap. Utility fraud alert template.
notes: Never ask for a PIN, password or full card number in the message. Quick replies like It was me / Not me give a fast, safe response path.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, we noticed a transaction of *{{amount}}* at {{merchant}} on your card ending in {{last4}}. Was this you?
